title: Closing Note
description: Join Tom Emrich, AR pioneer and author of The Next Dimension, for a closing keynote on how spatial computing is transforming business. Drawing from real-world examples, Emrich will explore how augmented reality is redefining customer engagement, marketing, and sales. He'll discuss the convergence of XR, AI, and immersive technologies, offering insights into how businesses can leverage these tools to create deeper connections and drive innovation. This session will provide a forward-looking perspective on the future of immersive technology and its role in shaping the next era of human interaction.
